resources.string: NTK (light and dark, follows the system)

Puts a small NTK button on every NTK stamp tag you see, such as [NTK e65ee28db5], in any app. To find tags, this service reads the text on your screen, on this phone only. It stores nothing and sends nothing. Only when you tap a button, the browser opens the verify page on ntk.tools with the stamp\'s id and the text in front of the tag; the text goes in the part of the address that browsers never send to a server.
